calls.purpose: 第一轮减少碎笔触，尚未达到定稿
calls.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production inventory item illustration for the Sichuan countryside idle travel game “旅行癞疙宝”.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target, the existing black rubber rain-boots concept. Image 2 is the user's real farm boots reference; use it only to preserve the practical tall rubber-boot silhouette, not its photographed texture, brand labels, legs or environment.
Primary request: Finish Image 1 as a clean, quiet hand-painted game asset: one pair of old-fashioned tall black rubber farm boots, empty and offset in a 3/4 front-side view. Keep the wide oval openings, straight tall shafts, rounded broad toes, low thick practical rubber soles and narrow muted brown-ochre cuff with thin warm cream edging.
Change only the surface treatment, breathing room and background: simplify the many tiny brush marks into broad coherent charcoal / very dark grey-green base shapes with just one broad soft muted-grey light plane on each shaft and toe. Simplify the brown cuff to one solid area and one gentle shadow. Preserve a soft gouache feel and dark brown organic outlines, but remove speckles, mottling, dense scratch marks and fragmented highlights. Keep only a tiny coherent muted-earth stain at a sole edge, no scattered mud dots.
Composition/framing: square canvas, both complete boots comfortably centered, about 76–80% of the canvas height, at least 9% clear margin on every side. Both boot openings and both soles must be fully visible. Maintain a readable silhouette at 65–93 px in-game.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent PNG with actual alpha=0 everywhere outside the boots, including the gap between them. Absolutely no drawn checkerboard, no white rectangle, no paper background, no ground, no cast shadow behind the boots.
Constraints: retain the pair of tall rural utilitarian black rubber boots and the same overall composition. No human legs, character, laces, zippers, buckles, logos, labels, words, extra objects, high fashion heels, noisy paper grain, glossy plastic shine or detailed dirt. Output only the finished illustrated boots.

calls.purpose: 第二轮合并明暗大块并简化口沿，采用此版去背景交付
calls.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: finished low-texture hand-painted game inventory icon.
Edit target: the supplied image of two tall black farm rain boots.
Keep the recognizable shape and arrangement: empty tall straight black rubber shafts, wide oval openings, narrow plain muted brown-ochre cuffs with fine cream rims, broad round toes, low flat thick soles, a staggered 3/4 front view. No words, labels, logos, people, legs, accessories or extra objects.
Repaint the boots with MUCH SIMPLER, broader contiguous colour shapes, similar to a quiet gouache storybook inventory drawing. The prior version still has dense, tiny angular brush marks everywhere: completely remove those angular fragments, mottling, speckles and small paint strokes. Use a dark charcoal base and just ONE calm broad grey-green highlight region on each shaft and each toe, plus the essential ankle creases. Cuffs should be almost solid ochre with one soft shadow, no mottled patches. Keep clean warm dark-brown outlines and a gentle hand-drawn feel, not photorealistic, not vector gloss.
Reduce the pair's scale on the square canvas to 78% of canvas height so there is at least 10% empty space above and below. Preserve all boot tips and soles.
Output on a genuine transparent alpha background. The checkerboard in the input is a defect to REMOVE; do not reproduce it, any grid, paper, white rectangle, shadow, floor or scenery. Everything outside the pair including the gap must have alpha=0. Only the two simplified boots on transparent PNG.

note: 两次内置编辑均返回 RGB 假透明；原样保留，程序去背景和补留白单独记录。
